overview_title: Assetz 63° East - A Landmark Township Redefining Luxury in East Bangalore
overview_body: Discover a self-sustaining mega ecosystem spanning a massive 26-acre master plan thoughtfully engineered by the [Assetz Property Group](https://www.assetzproperty.com/63east/). This monumental sustainable township seamlessly integrates 6 soaring high-rise towers rising up to 14 floors alongside 79 premium luxury row houses. Envisioned to perfectly balance personal sanctuary with eco-responsibility, the community is built on an IGBC Gold Rated "Carbon Healing Homes" concept, dedicating 68% of its territory to expansive green landscapes, tranquil courtyard pockets, and over 25 world-class amenities. Experience architectural excellence through impeccably crafted 1, 2, 3, and 4 BHK smart homes situated right off Sarjapur Road in Kodathi, offering unmatched, traffic-free connectivity to major IT corridors like RGA Tech Park, the Wipro Corporate Campus, Outer Ring Road (ORR), and Marathahalli.

qa_pairs.question: Who is the developer of this project?
qa_pairs.answer: The developer of this project is Assetz Property Group.

qa_pairs.question: What types of units are available in the newest tower phases, specifically Tower E?
qa_pairs.answer: The newest tower phases, including Tower E, offer ultra-premium, highly spatial 3 BHK and 4 BHK layouts.

qa_pairs.question: Where is this project located?
qa_pairs.answer: The project is located at Chikkakannalli / Kodathi, directly off Sarjapur Main Road in East Bangalore.

qa_pairs.question: What are some of the water management systems implemented in the development?
qa_pairs.answer: The development features dual plumbing lines, dual-flush sanitary fixtures, integrated rainwater harvesting, and groundwater recharging infrastructure, designed to save up to 74% fresh water.

qa_pairs.question: What is the RERA registration number for Tower E?
qa_pairs.answer: The RERA registration number for Tower E Phase is PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/201222/005546.

qa_pairs.question: What amenities are available in the clubhouse?
qa_pairs.answer: The 40,000 Sq.Ft. clubhouse features over 25 community and lifestyle assets, including 5 swimming pools, futsal fields, a tennis court, a basketball court, a skating rink, indoor squash courts, co-working areas, a child creche/daycare, an organic cultivation deck, and micro-retail bus bays.

qa_pairs.question: How well is the project connected to employment centers?
qa_pairs.answer: The project has immediate driving alignment to RGA Tech Park, Outer Ring Road (ORR) IT corridors, Wipro Corporate HQ, and nearby Bellandur / Marathahalli IT corridors.

posts.title: Why Sarjapur Road is East Bangalore's Most Lucrative Investment Corridor
posts.excerpt: An in-depth look at what this project has to offer.
content: Sarjapur Road has transitioned from a quiet suburban stretch into one of East Bangalore’s most dynamic commercial and residential epicenters. Driven by its exceptional physical infrastructure and strategic positioning, this micro-market has become the go-to destination for modern homebuyers and high-net-worth real estate investors alike.The primary catalyst behind this real estate surge is the seamless connectivity the locality offers. Nestled perfectly between the IT hubs of Whitefield, Electronic City, and the Outer Ring Road (ORR), Sarjapur Road allows working professionals to significantly cut down daily commute times. Furthermore, the expansion of the upcoming Metro line and the development of the Peripheral Ring Road (PRR) are set to unlock unprecedented capital appreciation over the next few years.Beyond transit links, the region is highly self-sustaining. It houses premium IT parks such as the RGA Tech Park and the sprawling Wipro Corporate Campus, creating a hyper-local employment ecosystem. Combined with top-tier international schools, multispecialty hospitals, and vibrant retail spaces, investing here guarantees not just exceptional rental yields but an appreciating luxury asset for long-term wealth creation.

posts.title: The Rise of Eco-Luxury: How Carbon Healing Homes Are Redefining Modern Living
content: Modern luxury is no longer just about imported marble floors or massive clubhouses; it is defined by the quality of the environment you breathe and live in. As urban spaces grow increasingly congested, a new wave of eco-luxury residential architecture—specifically Carbon Healing Homes—is quietly setting a healthier standard for families in Bangalore.An IGBC Gold-rated eco-luxury development changes how a household interacts with nature. By implementing advanced structural systems like dual-plumbing, high-efficiency fixtures, and integrated rainwater harvesting networks, these sustainable enclaves achieve up to 74% fresh water savings. Furthermore, on-site sewage treatment plants ensure that 100% of the estate's landscaping needs are met using recycled water, creating a zero-waste ecosystem.Living in a green-certified community translates to long-term wellness and lower maintenance overheads. With over 68% of the land area reserved for open green spaces, organic gardens, and pocket parks, residents experience better air quality and natural temperature regulation. Choosing an eco-luxury home means securing a premium lifestyle that preserves both your family’s well-being and the planet’s future.
